cursor.note: crossings are DERIVED from the journals and the stored arrays are gone: 42 lists and 1 prose string removed from the commons, 0 of 273 tickets carry the key. The reading verb is ONE, not two. The build shipped a second verb, proven_by_latest, reading the latest crossing that names a proof, and cited a ticket named proven-by-answers-two-questions-and-one-reader-serves-both as its authority. THAT TICKET DOES NOT EXIST in either root and the citation was authored in this voyage's own build commit 5f44a62, so no ruling stood behind the split and the measurement was free to settle it. It loses evidence for a structural reason: ONE CROSSING ACT IS JOURNALED AT EVERY COMPONENT ADDRESS IT TOUCHES (Law 5), so the last RECORD is one component's share of the act, not the act. Measured against the stored arrays at b9828a2^, the last-record reading was a strict subset on 4 of 42 tickets and 9579a6f9cec6 lost five proofs at once. proven_by_since_buildme reads 34 identical, 6 derived-superset, 0 loss, and all three consumers -- hollow, proof_coverage's gate, codemother's shim -- now ask it by name. The chart's own hypothesize berth had charted the union; the build had deviated from its own design, so restoring it was in bounds. ALSO FOUND AND RECORDED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED: 13 tickets resolve no forward BUILDME in any journal -- 11 whose only BUILDME entry carries direction 'back' (a kick-back, 8 of them in one timestamp cluster at 2026-09-07T19:36:4x), 1 with records but no BUILDME, 1 with no journal record at all. The stored arrays carried no direction field, so hollow would have reverted those to a kick-back point; it now raises HollowUnmeasurable loudly instead (Law 7). And the union makes lacks() GROW on 24 tickets, because every extra proof brings its own proof_declares_the_ticket and seal_fingerprint_current lack. The criterion's parenthetical expected a red to clear and the change runs the other way. The falsifier -- a ticket green today and red after the switch -- is 0 over 273, and that is the clause that decides it: the union demands more evidence, it excuses none.

window.note:
bus_client is its own tool at its own address, and the gate component it lodged in is PURE DETERMINISTIC again. The falsifier — test_q_the_real_corpus_has_gates_and_not_one_consults_an_oracle — was RED at baseline naming all eight components and reads 'ok' now, and bin/cmd/determinism went 8 VIOLATION blocks -> 1 (after the discover() lift alone) -> 0 (after the git mv). THE MIDDLE READING IS THE POINT: an instrument that reported 0 because it had gone blind could not have produced the 1.

AND THE GREEN IS NOT A BLIND ONE. The oracle reach RELOCATED rather than vanished: cairn/tools/bus_client is a roster row that did not exist at baseline and it carries its own 'LLM IN THE LOOP: cairn.devices.inference_domain' line, with five further chains (aider_shim, codemother/seed_trees, librarian/shim, tester/cli, web_server/listener) now routing their reach through it. The edge is still seen; it left the gate's directory.

NINETEEN import sites across thirteen files, not the eighteen across eleven the survey measured — cairn/devices/codemother/0/bin/codemother and cairn/devices/trouble/0/bin/trouble are extensionless BASH shims carrying embedded python imports, and no --include=*.py sweep can see them. That miss is a finding about the survey leg, not about the builder's attention.

TWO PROOFS, not the one the chart named: the moved probe's proof (six load-bearing path strings, not five — _PROBE_MOD at line 34 was the sixth and it is what raised ModuleNotFoundError after the first five were fixed), and proofs/test_the_three_faces_resolve_a_shim_from_disk.py, which the ticket's gates_bound demanded and NO chart leg mentioned. A bound gate can outrun the decompose split.

Both were shown capable of failing rather than assumed to be: the moved proof RED with the old strings stale and green rewritten; tooth v RED against a deliberately planted old-address importer and green once it was removed. Tooth v's red arrives as an uncaught ModuleNotFoundError from the real import rather than as its own named assertion, because the live import runs before the stale list is asserted — loud and correct, but a diagnostic surface would rather be told the file than handed a stack (Law 7).

FIXED IN PASSING under the bounds ruling 2026-09-09-a-bug-the-voyage-uncovers-is-fixed-by-that-voyage: two bare tempfile.mkdtemp calls routed through the scratch_dir door, and operator_inbox's _with_derived_phase made PUBLIC — it was private and therefore uncallable, and the first consequence was harbor_master's own register proof becoming the second reader it exists to forbid. An overlay only one module can reach is a one-reader rule with a private door.

THE PROMOTION GATE TAUGHT THIS VOYAGE TWO THINGS AND BOTH ANSWERS ALREADY EXISTED. (a) survey_holdings_resolve re-resolves a survey's holdings against the POST-build world, so a ticket whose work IS a move makes its own survey stale by construction; the settled mechanism is a FORWARDING ORDER on the ticket, checked at both ends in the world (the from must not resolve, the to must), and this ticket now carries one for its three moved addresses. (b) The clearance gate refused for crossing_record_absent: NOTHING IN THE SYSTEM WRITES A TICKET'S crossings ARRAY — only readers exist (proof_coverage, hollow) — so the crossings this voyage really made, journaled at both components with timestamps and gate results, had to be transcribed onto the ticket by hand. That is an IOU to cast, not a thing to build here: this voyage's constrain berth puts the emit chokepoint explicitly OUT of bounds. Neither answer added machinery.

THE HOLLOW READING REFUSED THE FIRST ATTEMPT AT THIS CROSSING, AND BOTH FINDINGS WERE AGAINST THE PROOFS. (1) UNREADABLE: reverting cairn/tools/bus_client/bus_client.py made test_the_three_faces_resolve_a_shim_from_disk.py print no teeth at all — it bound the module under test at import time, so taking the module away raised before the first tooth. 'The proof crashed' and 'no tooth checks this file' are different answers and the gate is right to keep them apart. The module now resolves through a call-time proxy that forwards __setattr__ as well as __getattr__ (the teeth monkeypatch the module object itself, and a read-only proxy would have passed tooth ii while measuring nothing), and check() runs every tooth in a try/except so a raising tooth cannot hide the ones after it — which matters most here, because the declared tooth is the LAST one. (2) SIX HOLLOW FILES: this build's own charter, its WATCHME probe, and the state/history journals at BOTH seam ends reverted with nothing going red. The two proofs above are evidence that the CODE moved and that the gate's directory came out pure; neither is evidence about a charter berthing at the new address or a cursor agreeing with its own journal — and 'bus_client is its own tool, not a lodger' is a claim about exactly those. proofs/test_the_tool_stands_at_its_own_address.py carries that half, as ONE deliberately fat declared tooth: this ticket's falsifier has no (N) markers, so it is a single 'all' clause, and PROVES maps one tooth per clause per proof — six small teeth could not all be declared. Its journal check is an INVARIANT, never a snapshot: it asserts that state.json's cursor IS history.json's last entry, which is true at every standing and false the moment either file is reverted alone.

ONE MORE FINDING, ABOUT THE INSTRUMENT RATHER THAN THIS BUILD: a proof with no standing validation gets isolation 'none' from cli.isolation_for(), so its FIRST `--seal` run reports [seal=open] and does not seal, while the same run prints 'SEALED — N VALIDATION(s) persisted'. A brand-new proof needs --netns on its first seal or it silently arrives unsealed.

The derivation is built and the six readers ask the journals. This crossing seals the proof over it.

THE PROOF GAINED FOUR THINGS BEFORE IT COULD CARRY THIS CROSSING:
  1. A PROVES DECLARATION. Without one, cairn test --hollow refuses outright — undeclared coverage cannot be measured. Clauses (a)..(d) now each name one tooth.
  2. CLAUSE (b) HAD NO TOOTH. 'All six readers call it instead of ticket.get(crossings)' is a fact about three files, not about any fixture world, so the tooth reads the three gate readers and reds if any takes its evidence from the stored array. Measured at the pre-build commit 8bca770403d8: proof_coverage carried it at two sites, hollow at two, the shim at one.
  3. CLAUSE (d) HAD NO TOOTH. hollow._buildme_at's day-granular fallback returned '2026-09-01' pre-build for a crossing with no time; it now refuses. git rev-list --before resolves a bare date to the last commit before that day STARTED, so the retired branch reverted a same-day build to a whole day early and said nothing.
  4. THE DERIVATION WAS BOUND AT IMPORT, which is the UNRAN defect wearing another coat. crossings.py did not exist before this build, so the hollow reader's removal of it turned the proof into a collection error: no tooth ran, nothing printed, and the reading said only 'the proof never reached a check'. The name now resolves on first attribute access inside the tooth that wants it, so the removal reds teeth BY NAME.

The watch is armed at cairn/tools/base/probes/no_ticket_carries_a_stored_crossing.py, and clause (c)'s tooth now asserts it loads and declares both halves of a Probe — because the corpus scan is a snapshot and the ticket's horizon is a span.
